description: City of Port Phillip Community Bus Routes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Port Phillip. Network showing locations of Community Bus Routes within City of Port Phillip. The free City of Port Phillip bus routes cover Elwood, St Kilda West, St Kilda East, Ripponlea, South Melbourne, Middle Park, Albert Park, Garden City and Port Melbourne areas. Coverage: City of Port Phillip. The portal files it under the publisher City of Port Phillip. Its tags are Community Bus, bus routes, ocd.commnunitybusroutes. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
